column5: Standing rule fixing what conformance may assert -- the promise, never the mechanism -- binding every future obligation
Makes passing the suite the binding condition on the claim "supports backend X"; spans rule and gate, higher taken
Draws the refusal rule by what is promised: a configuration breaking a promised invariant is refused at open
Removes the configuration escape from a corruption guard, making it a constraint no build can switch off
Fixes who may extend the system: the trait stays sealed, so an outsider verifies but cannot ship an adapter
Lays down the criterion that separates API from data -- type names and paths in, string contents out
Governs the non_exhaustive lever itself: exemption is derived from the spec's closed-by-construction designation
Fixes what physically travels in each published tarball rather than what the manifest claims
Sets the delay between decision and name acquisition, carrying the squatting risk to publish
Fixes the artefact topology of the repo: one workspace, crates under crates/, spec and ADR tree beside them
Standing dependency rule: caret plus lockstep, exact pins forbidden at publish so version unification holds
States the floor as a rule -- oldest stable compiling the frozen surface -- not as a number that would drift
Splits what binds from what freezes, and when: the single statement governing every later regime assignment
Decides what the spec discloses about platforms: a positive list, no exclusion list, unverified recorded as unverified
Buys the irreversible half now and omits the reversible half, fixing what may still be added at a minor
Scope boundary: correlation is deferred to an external standard and pardosa carries nothing natively
Constrains when a yank is permitted -- correctness or safety only -- and obliges a published policy without an SLA
Discloses the maintainer relationship a stranger cannot otherwise see, and withholds any response-time promise
Standing prohibition on contrastive definition: positive definition only, for any X, binding all future text
Fixes where normative force lives: the page orients and never adds, so one artefact binds rather than two
Keeps the enumeration open, so obligations may be added in any release without a compatibility cost
Assigns the bar to the invariant regime, deciding when it binds rather than what it says
Sets enforcement strength: presence gated, quality damped by a record rather than a gate or checklist
Fixes which artefact exists at 0.5.1 to hold the binding prose, rather than deferring it to a later consolidation
Fixes one concrete path value, named for the line it specifies, so citations stay stable across majors
Puts a regime marker on every clause, making stability promise a per-clause property distinct from force
Defines what the regime marker answers -- does breaking this break a consumer -- separating force from mutability
Decides how the document explains its own name where it is read, since the non-normative page never reaches that reader
Routes the reader to the clause instead of restating it, keeping the two-regime rule stated exactly once
Decides what the frozen surface exposes: the word is taught vocabulary, never a public type
Fixes how many entities a stranger must learn at this level, making event line an aspect rather than a noun
Splits the layout by axis into what binds from 0.5.1 and what freezes at 1.0
Chooses the frame the concept is understood from -- ordering first, durability and containment as consequences
Permanent scope boundary: partitioning is a topology choice above pardosa, never inside an artefact
Converts an implementation fact into a promise with a regime marker, so a consumer may rely on it
Withholds any identity a stranger could hold; the locator names it extrinsically and the frontier is the comparable value
Refuses a second irreversible envelope slot, leaving the one already bought as the standing escape hatch
Applies the language rule as a refusal: a backend noun is barred from consumer vocabulary by any path
Reserves structure now so the licensed split is reachable later without breaking old readers
States the containment invariant a fiber never violates, which is what keeps linearizability true under partitioning
Splits visibility in two: an operator can name a dragline through the read-only surface, a consumer cannot
